finding: The built gate fails a Python file that radon cannot parse (BUG-0072). BR-130 does not say whether the Python template exits non-zero for such a file or skips it, and a skipped file passes. Add the case to BR-130 and the feature file: the command reports the file as a row with parse_error, and crap-score fails with exit 1 and names the file (DEC-34). Owner: domain-modeling-agent.
why_this_severity: An implementer can choose an outcome and the gate still ends with a verdict (no to fails_purpose); the test of BUG-0072 has no rule to replace it (raises_cost). No story or code outside the run encodes the statements.
